name: The Waters Above: Prelude
source:
A giant dome called the Vault of Heaven covers the earth, separating it from the vast ocean of the heavens. In this world, sea nymphs care for the stars in the sky, dedicating their lives to it. However, magic is fading, the stars are dying, and no one knows why. No one even speaks of it, carrying on like they have for tens of thousands of years, as if nothing has changed. In these circumstances, three sea nymphs and the living embodiment of a star struggle to find meaning in their lives and their fading world.

[From [url=https://vnstudioelan.itch.io/the-waters-above-prelude]itch.io[/url]]

The Waters Above: Prelude was a prequel story to a planned game called 'Starkeeper: The Waters Above', but [url=https://old.reddit.com/r/visualnovels/comments/by56gk/looks_like_studio_élans_starkeeper_the_waters/]the latter has since been canceled[/url].
translation:
一个名为“天之穹顶”的巨大圆顶覆盖着地球，将它与浩瀚的天空之海隔开。在这个世界里，海之精灵照料天空中的星辰，用一生奉献于此。然而，魔法正在消退，星辰正在死去，却没有人知道原因。没人提起这件事，所有人都像过去数万年那样继续生活，仿佛一切从未改变。在这样的环境中，三名海之精灵与一颗星辰的生命化身努力寻找自己以及这个逐渐消逝世界的意义。

（来源：[url=https://vnstudioelan.itch.io/the-waters-above-prelude]itch.io[/url]）

《天之水：序曲》原本是计划中游戏《星辰守护者：天之水》的前传故事，但[url=https://old.reddit.com/r/visualnovels/comments/by56gk/looks_like_studio_élans_starkeeper_the_waters/]后者后来已被取消[/url]。
